integrity: The exact first-public date is the arXiv v1 date printed on arXiv:0711.4345v1 (27 November 2007). Primary MSC ownership is independently verified from the full text of the cited 2021 perfect-domination paper, which lists 05C69. The complete-bipartite boundary is proved independently because that source appears to undercount its two-vertex sets.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected chain graphs and ordinary outside-only perfect domination. The exhaustive computation through order 10 is corroborative only; the general result rests on the structural proof. Literature searches cannot exclude an obscure equivalent statement under substantially different terminology.
title: Minimum perfect dominating sets of connected chain graphs
